sentences.en: Moving a huge boulder is going to be very hard.
sentences.zh: 移动一块巨大的大石头将会非常困难。

sentences.en: It's smaller than a boulder and larger than a pebble.
sentences.zh: 它的大小比鹅卵石大，但比大石头小。

sentences.en: Mr Sato was standing on top of a boulder.
sentences.zh: 佐藤先生站在一块大石头上面。

senses.zh: 卵石，圆石,巨砾，冰砾,漂砾
